verdict.rationale: The evidence shows programmatic surfaces beyond the UI. The official CLI runs test, monitor, code test, IaC, secrets scans and agentic fix, and works in CI/CD. A local MCP server built on the CLI exposes scanning to agents, and the API & Web CLI supports bulk operations on targets, scans and findings. However, nothing in the pack documents a general REST API or claims parity with UI functions, and the OpenAPI probes on the docs domain all returned 404. Missing for 10: documented public REST API reference, an OpenAPI spec, API coverage of UI features such as reporting dashboards, policy management, RBAC and org/project administration, and any evidence of UI–API parity.
